Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring plans that provide coverage for prostheses to provide coverage for hearing aids.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to coverage for hearing aids and cochlear implants;adding a new section to chapter 41.05 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 48.20 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 48.21 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 48.44 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter48.46 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All statepurchased health care that provides coverage forprostheses must include coverage for hearing aids and cochlear implantsif the patient's physician or advanced registered nurse practitioner asauthorized by the nursing care quality assurance commission underchapter 18.79 RCW or physician assistant under chapter 18.71A RCWrecommends the hearing aid or cochlear implant. This section does not prevent the application of standard healthplan provisions applicable to other benefits such as deductible orcopayment provisions or limit the authority of the state health careauthority to negotiate rates and contract with specific providers for p. 1 HB 2890the delivery of prostheses. This section does not apply to medicaresupplement policies or supplemental contracts covering a specifieddisease or other limited benefits.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An insurer that offers to any individual a health benefit plan thatprovides coverage for prostheses must include coverage for hearing aidsand cochlear implants if the patient's physician or advanced registerednurse practitioner as authorized by the nursing care quality assurancecommission under chapter 18.79 RCW or physician assistant under chapter18.71A RCW recommends the hearing aid or cochlear implant. This section does not prevent the application of standard healthplan provisions applicable to other benefits such as deductible orcopayment provisions or limit the authority of the state health careauthority to negotiate rates and contract with specific providers forthe delivery of prostheses. This section does not apply to medicaresupplement policies or supplemental contracts covering a specifieddisease or other limited benefits.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A group insurance contract or blanket disability insurance contractthat provides coverage for prostheses must include coverage for hearingaids and cochlear implants if the patient's physician or advancedregistered nurse practitioner as authorized by the nursing care qualityassurance commission under chapter 18.79 RCW or physician assistantunder chapter 18.71A RCW recommends the hearing aid or cochlearimplant. This section does not prevent the application of standard healthplan provisions applicable to other benefits such as deductible orcopayment provisions or limit the authority of the state health careauthority to negotiate rates and contract with specific providers forthe delivery of prostheses. This section does not apply to medicaresupplement policies or supplemental contracts covering a specifieddisease or other limited benefits.

BillSection.RCWSLText: A health service contractor that provides coverage for prosthesesmust include coverage for hearing aids and cochlear implants if thepatient's physician or advanced registered nurse practitioner asauthorized by the nursing care quality assurance commission underchapter 18.79 RCW or physician assistant under chapter 18.71A RCWrecommends the hearing aid or cochlear implant.
